description: For every expanded formula, the formula computed by graph elimination is chosen before the model and preserves truth in every expansion satisfying the defining axioms.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DefinitionalExtensions.DefinitionPackage.uniform_elimination.{u, v, u', v', w, z}
  {L : FirstOrder.Language} {K : FirstOrder.Language} {α : Type z}
  (d : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.DefinitionalExtensions.DefinitionPackage L K) (A : (L.sum K).Formula α) :
  ∃ B,
    B = d.translate A ∧
      ∀ (M : Type w) [inst : L.Structure M] [inst_1 : (L.sum K).Structure M]
        [FirstOrder.Language.LHom.sumInl.IsExpansionOn M], M ⊨ d.definitions → ∀ (v : α → M), B.Realize v ↔ A.Realize v
